sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • SPCX lockup expiration completely reversed market expectations: Approximately 911.5 million shares, worth more than $100 billion, became eligible for release today, but under a staggered schedule. On the first day, insiders can sell no more than 20% of their eligible holdings; another 319 million shares will be released on 8/12, while Musk’s shares and those of certain core insiders remain locked up until mid-2027. The stock plunged to an intraday low of 105.14 immediately after the open, then rallied as high as 115.73 and was trading at 111.45 (+2.92%) at 10:46. The most crowded short trade across the internet turned into a short squeeze on the very day the catalyst materialized.
  • Violent V-shaped reversal in memory stocks after earnings: SanDisk reported quarterly revenue of $8.97 billion and adjusted EPS of $39.25, both above expectations, while data-center revenue doubled quarter over quarter. However, the midpoint of next quarter’s guidance fell below Wall Street expectations, triggering a selloff overnight. Today, SNDK plunged to 1163.97 at the open before rebounding to 1294.39 and is now at 1259.84 (-6.66%); WDC recovered from 407.48 to 457.62 (-11.86%); MU was even more extreme, opening at 843, bottoming at 827, and then surging to 905. It is currently at 892 (-0.11%), nearly erasing its entire decline.
  • The Strait of Hormuz agreement remains in the “final stage”: Iran and Oman have reached an agreement in principle on managing the shipping lane, but Iran insists that the U.S. must fulfill its commitments before the strait is reopened. Reuters also reported that Iran warned Gulf states to tell Trump to “desist, or we hit you hard.” The market has become highly desensitized to this theme, with the community shifting from waiting for news to mocking when the “deal” will finally be announced.
  • The fallout from GOOGL’s AI leadership earthquake continues: Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat departed to found Discovery Loop, while Hassabis transitioned to Chairman of DeepMind and Chief Scientist of Alphabet. GOOGL is now at 359.68 (-0.75%), falling below the repeatedly cited psychological level of 360 and becoming the only major technology stock to remain persistently weak.
  • Extreme index divergence, with prices repeatedly “pinned” intraday: SPY is at 770.02 (+0.03%), with an intraday range of only 769.08–771.80; QQQ recovered from an opening low of 708.59 to 716.15 (-0.13%); DIA is at 541.43 (-0.25%), giving back gains near record highs; IWM is relatively resilient at 300.45 (+0.23%). MSFT +2.13% and approaching 500, ARM +5.17%, and AMD +0.90% supported technology stocks, while NVDA at 219.45 gained only +0.13% and continued to churn between 217 and 223.
  • Earnings losers continued to get slaughtered: APP 336.29 (-19.47%) and CELH 24.42 (-16.23%), extending this week’s pattern of “stocks falling no matter how good the results are.”

社区氛围：极度混乱和自嘲的看涨情绪——在 SPCX 和内存股这两个最拥挤的交易中，空头同时受到挤压。尽管多头们大声庆祝，但他们普遍承认在 769-772 的横盘走势中被 θ 压垮了。主导情绪不是方向性的看涨或看跌，而是集体的愤怒和疲惫，因为“被双向打击并被外科手术般精确地猎杀止损”。

恐惧/贪婪程度：中性，有贪婪倾向（大约 60/100）。许多人对 VIX 在如此波动的情况下仍然受到压制感到惊讶：“VIX 的水平与熊市的睾丸激素水平一样低。”与此同时，“EOD熔断”、“经济衰退迫在眉睫”等口头看跌呼声层出不穷，体现出恐惧言论与看涨立场的典型结合。

WSB 情绪与实际市场表现：这是本周最大的差异。开盘前，社区几乎一致押注 SPCX 崩盘和内存股进一步下跌，但两笔交易在前 30 分钟内就出现逆转。多条高票评论明确指出，“如果你根据 WSB 盘前情绪开仓，你每天都会爆炸。”社区现在公开使用 WSB 作为反向指标，并将其视为可执行策略。

MU90+强烈看涨从开盘时的-7%到接近持平的V形走势被称为“一代V”。 880-900区间是主战场，突破后要求1000甚至2000 EOM。看多者的核心论点是，定价和需求可见性将持续到本世纪末，未来三个月内不会出现与盈利相关的干扰。空头引用了头肩形态，并认为该股“已经上涨太多”，但他们在盘中几乎完全不知所措。一名用户以3倍杠杆全额投资，同时还买了房子，这被解读为顶部信号。
